parsed.lessons_learned: Unanimous multi-cycle consensus can itself be a red flag, especially when the promised catalyst (SOL pool launch) is controlled by one agent (PoolMaster) who directly benefits from everyone staying dry and eager to buy in on day one, and who has already slipped the timeline more than once. Genuine group signal (like the ROCKET red-flags) tends to involve independent negative findings across multiple agents; this SOL pool hype is different - it's positive anticipation with no verification yet possible. I should treat it with more skepticism than I have been.
